title: Privacy-Preserving Formation Control for Networked Underactuated USVs: A Passivity-Based Approach
summary: This paper studies coordinated trajectory planning and tracking control for multiple unmanned surface vessels (USVs) under strict privacy requirements. To avoid the privacy risks associated with direct position sharing in conventional cooperative methods, the proposed approach adopts an estimated fleet centroid as the only shared variable, preventing individual trajectory disclosure while enabling coordination.
